'''Cadannia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] presumably completely, or mostly covered in dense [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] or [[Forest/Legends|forests]] that produced some of the galaxy's strongest [[Poison/Legends|toxins]].<ref name="Mission" />

[[Senflax]], which secreted a powerful neurotoxin, could only be found on Cadannia. This plant was capable of causing muscle and neural paralysis, and temporarily disrupted one's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
